statusPolicy.implemented: Has source paths, tests, and at least three evidence anchors that exist in those files or in the reference-app topology.
statusPolicy.planned: Must not claim implementation or tests; promotion requires three or more explicit criteria before a release note.

goZeroAlignment.strategy: Align SQL access with SQLStore and NewCluster instead of go-zero sqlx, and align cache-aside repositories with the typed cache package instead of go-zero cache helpers.
goZeroAlignment.rollbackOrEscalation: Keep the existing go-zero datastore, pin REFERENCE_APP_MODE=memory, and rerun make goctl-model-parity-replay-check before promoting generated SQL or cache output.
requiredEvidence: SQL read/write strategy through SQLStore and NewCluster
transaction examples through SQLStore.Transact and SQL outbox
generated model cache contracts through RedisCachedOrderRepo and UpdateWithInvalidate
Redis/cache observability through cache stats and WritePrometheus
local smoke tests through examples/goctl-model/cache-local and reference-app-smoke

rows.adapter: SQLStore.Transact and Cluster.Transact run caller work on the primary writer.
rows.dependencyBoundary: Root-owned storage runtime; generated repositories call Transact without adding GORM to the root module.
rows.observabilityEvidence: Transaction failures wrap driver errors so tests and logs keep the SQL operation name.
rows.fallbackBehavior: Fallback to sqlite-memory when no clustered primary or replica DSN is configured for local proof.
rows.rollbackOrEscalation: Disable replica routing, keep the primary SQLStore, and rerun storage tests before publishing SQL claims.

rows.adapter: SQL outbox Enqueue shares the caller transaction, then the relay publishes to a broker.
rows.dependencyBoundary: Root-owned outbox runtime stays independent of generated project go.mod files.
rows.observabilityEvidence: Relay logs outbox relay batch failed with attempt counts and last_error for operators.
rows.fallbackBehavior: Fallback to the memory store and in-process broker when SQL is unavailable in unit tests.
rows.rollbackOrEscalation: Stop the relay, keep pending rows, and republish after the broker health check recovers.

rows.adapter: Redis model cache uses NewRedisModel cache-aside with redis.ErrNil miss semantics.
rows.dependencyBoundary: Generated RedisCachedOrderRepo depends on cache and core/kv/redis written into the generated project go.mod.
rows.observabilityEvidence: Cache stats and WritePrometheus export hit, miss, and load counts for operators.
rows.fallbackBehavior: Fallback to GOFLY_CACHE_DISABLED so loaders hit SQL directly in tests and local smoke.
rows.rollbackOrEscalation: Unset Redis client options, disable cache-aside, and serve FindOne from the SQL repository.

rows.adapter: typed local Cache and tiered cache composition cover GetOrLoad, negative cache, and bloom guards.
rows.dependencyBoundary: Root-owned cache package; examples/goctl-model/cache-local is a copyable module, not a root import.
rows.observabilityEvidence: The cache-local example emits gofly.cache_local.v1 together with cache.Stats so operators can prove typed local and tiered cache behavior.
rows.fallbackBehavior: Fallback to GOFLY_CACHE_DISABLED so unit tests never require a live Redis process.
rows.rollbackOrEscalation: Keep the in-memory Cache constructor and skip tiered Redis until the local report schema stays green.

rows.adapter: generated cache invalidation uses UpdateWithInvalidate and afterUpdateCommit after repository writes.
rows.dependencyBoundary: Generated RedisCachedOrderRepo and cache helpers stay in the generated project, not the root go.mod.
rows.observabilityEvidence: Generator tests pin RedisCachedOrderRepo, FlushAfterCommit, and DiscardAfterCommit markers so invalidation stays visible in generated output.
rows.fallbackBehavior: Fallback to direct repository writes when Redis is unset or GOFLY_CACHE_DISABLED is true.
rows.rollbackOrEscalation: Regenerate without --cache, keep SQL repositories, and rerun TestGenerateModelFromDDL before a release.

capabilities.adopterValue: SQLStore and Cluster give generated services transactions, dialects, and read/write split without importing GORM into gofly itself.
capabilities.rollbackNote: Pin DialectSQLite for local tests and keep the primary writer if replica routing fails.

capabilities.adopterValue: Enqueue inside the business transaction, then relay to a broker with at-least-once delivery.
capabilities.rollbackNote: Pause the relay, leave pending rows in SQL, and republish after broker health recovers.

capabilities.adopterValue: Typed Cache[T] with single-flight load, TTL, and optional tiered backends for hot keys.
capabilities.rollbackNote: Set GOFLY_CACHE_DISABLED and serve loader results without retaining process-local entries.

capabilities.adopterValue: Strict cache-aside Redis model cache with typed keys and miss semantics via redis.ErrNil.
capabilities.rollbackNote: Drop the Redis client and call the SQL repository FindOne path until Redis miss tests pass.

capabilities.adopterValue: gofly model emits SQL repositories, cache-aside wrappers, and go.mod edits only in the target module.
capabilities.rollbackNote: Regenerate without cache flags and keep SQL-only repositories in the generated module.

capabilities.adopterValue: production-orders and cache-local show SQL outbox plus local cache reports operators can copy.
capabilities.rollbackNote: Pin REFERENCE_APP_MODE=memory and keep the in-memory outbox until Docker adapters recover.

capabilities.adopterValue: Versioned SQL migrations that generated services can run without a third-party runner in the root module.
promotionCriteria: Dedicated migration API with up/down and checksum verification
Temporary generated-project compile test that does not pollute root go.mod
Rollback notes and a make gate that fail closed on dirty schema
capabilities.rollbackNote: Do not advertise a migration runner in release notes until implementation and tests exist.

capabilities.adopterValue: Live Redis integration in production-orders Docker mode with cache-aside and invalidation proof.
promotionCriteria: Docker compose Redis used by production-orders beyond topology labels
Fail-closed tests for Redis miss, invalidation, and GOFLY_CACHE_DISABLED
Observability showing cache.Stats on the reference-app admin surface
capabilities.rollbackNote: Keep memory mode as the blocking reference-app gate until live Redis proof exists.

workflowMatrix.observability: Generator tests pin Transact signatures so runtime SQL errors stay wrapped in repository methods.
workflowMatrix.rollbackNote: Regenerate SQL repositories without cache wrappers and keep SQLStore.Transact as the only writer path.

workflowMatrix.observability: Cursor and offset helpers share dialect placeholders so Postgres and SQLite page the same repository API.
workflowMatrix.rollbackNote: Keep ListAfter and LimitOffset in generated repos and skip page caches until SQL page tests pass.

workflowMatrix.observability: Version mismatches return storage.ErrNotFound so callers distinguish lost updates from missing rows.
workflowMatrix.rollbackNote: Disable UpdateWithVersion in generated output and document last-write-wins until lock tests pass.

workflowMatrix.observability: FOR UPDATE statements stay on the primary so replica lag cannot serve locked rows.
workflowMatrix.rollbackNote: Construct repositories with the primary SQLStore only and skip NewCluster until replica tests pass.

workflowMatrix.observability: WritePrometheus and cache.Stats expose hit/miss/load counts for local and Redis-backed caches.
workflowMatrix.rollbackNote: Disable Prometheus export and keep GOFLY_CACHE_DISABLED until cache stats tests stay green.

workflowMatrix.observability: Temporary modules run go test ./... so generated cache repositories compile outside the root module.
workflowMatrix.rollbackNote: Skip Redis cache generation and keep SQL-only temp-module smoke until compile tests pass.

p10StorageCacheProductization.goZeroGapClosure: Close the go-zero sqlx and cache gap by shipping SQLStore/NewCluster, SQL outbox transactions, generated RedisCachedOrderRepo contracts, cache stats, and local cache-local plus production-orders smoke without claiming sqlx drop-in parity.
p10StorageCacheProductization.promotionPolicy: Promote only when read/write routing, transaction examples, generated model cache contracts, Redis/cache observability, local smoke, and rollback notes are all green.
p10StorageCacheProductization.runtimeArtifactPolicy: Keep runtime evidence in tracked examples and docs; ignored temporary paths must not be cited as product proof.

rows.rollbackOrEscalation: Use the primary SQLStore only and skip replica routing until FOR UPDATE tests pass on the writer.
Keep Enqueue inside Transact and pause the outbox relay until broker tests recover.
Regenerate SQL-only repositories and drop Redis cache types until generator markers match.
Disable cache export and set GOFLY_CACHE_DISABLED until WritePrometheus tests pass.
Pin REFERENCE_APP_MODE=memory and copy cache-local until Docker Redis proof is added.

p13DBCacheProductization.objective: Ship a SQL repository template with transaction, pagination, optimistic-lock, read/write split, Redis cache-aside, cache observability, generated DB/cache smoke, and a cache hot-path candidate without promoting benchmark claims.
p13DBCacheProductization.promotionPolicy: Each row needs source, tests, runtime evidence, generated evidence, and rollback notes; cache hot-path performance remains candidate until P13-06.
p13DBCacheProductization.rootModulePolicy: Generated-project-only dependencies such as GORM stay in the generated project go.mod and must never land in the root go.mod.

rows.rollbackOrEscalation: Keep Mongo/GORM styles isolated and regenerate SQL repos until FindWhere markers compile.
Call SQLStore.Transact directly from handlers until generated OrderRepo.Transact markers return.
Serve List queries without cursor helpers until ListAfter compile tests pass.
Document last-write-wins and skip version columns until UpdateWithVersion markers compile.
Construct NewOrderRepo with the primary store and skip WithCluster until ForQuery tests pass.
Generate SQL repositories without Redis wrappers until cache-aside markers compile.
Keep cache-local schema gofly.cache_local.v1 and skip Prometheus until WritePrometheus tests pass.
Keep SQL-only temp modules and skip Redis cache compile until go test ./... stays green.

rows.promotionBoundary: P13-06 must collect five baseline samples before cache hot-path leaves candidate status.
rows.rollbackOrEscalation: Keep cache-hot-path report-only in release notes until five baseline samples exist.
